name: Disable DM
description: A Mattermost plugin to disable direct messages and group chats with team-based whitelist support.

settings_schema.header: Configure direct message and group chat restrictions. Use team whitelist to allow specific teams to bypass restrictions.
settings_schema.footer: Note: Users must be members of at least one whitelisted team to send DMs/group messages when whitelist is enabled.

settings.help_text: If enabled, the plugin will reject direct messages (subject to whitelist rules).
If enabled, the plugin will reject messages sent to group chats (subject to whitelist rules).
The message displayed to users when their direct message or group chat is blocked.
settings.default: Direct messages have been disabled by an administrator.

settings.help_text: If enabled, only users who are members of the whitelisted teams can send DMs and group messages. All others will be blocked.
Comma-separated list of team names (not display names) that are allowed to send DMs and group messages. Example: staff-team,admin-team
